import { createCalculator, type CalculationComponent, type CalculationRequest, type CalculationResult, type Subtotal } from "@kmodels/pricing";

const component: CalculationComponent = { id: "request-1", offerRef: "0".repeat(64), quantities: [] };
const request: CalculationRequest = { evaluatedAt: "2026-09-27T00:00:00Z", components: [component] };
declare const data: unknown;
const calculator = createCalculator(data);
const result = calculator.calculate(request);
function readTotals(result: CalculationResult): Subtotal[] {
  if (result.status === "calculated" || result.status === "estimated") return result.totals;
  const absent: undefined = result.totals;
  return absent ?? [];
}
for (const charge of result.charges) {
  charge.unitPrice.per.factors;
  charge.binding.signal;
}
for (const requirement of calculator.requirements({ offerRef: component.offerRef }).charges) {
  if (requirement.kind === "rate") requirement.selectorSources;
  if (requirement.kind === "contribution") requirement.referencedRates;
  if (requirement.kind === "allowance") {
    requirement.reset;
    requirement.benefit;
    requirement.target;
  }
}
// @ts-expect-error Complete results must include totals.
const invalidComplete: CalculationResult = { ...result, status: "calculated", totals: undefined };
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete results cannot include totals.
const invalidPartial: CalculationResult = { ...result, status: "partial", totals: [] };
void [readTotals, invalidComplete, invalidPartial];
